title: Voz pasiva para describir la privatización

sections.content: The passive voice is useful when the process matters more than the actor.

items.spanish: Muchas empresas públicas fueron privatizadas durante los años noventa, aunque el proceso generó un intenso debate.
items.english: Many public enterprises were privatised during the 1990s, although the process generated intense debate.

items.spanish: La propiedad estatal fue transferida a inversionistas privados en sectores como telecomunicaciones y energía.
items.english: State ownership was transferred to private investors in sectors such as telecommunications and energy.

items.spanish: Los servicios básicos fueron gestionados por compañías privadas que buscaban mayor eficiencia.
items.english: Basic services were managed by private companies seeking greater efficiency.

items.spanish: La privatización fue defendida por algunos y criticada por otros.
items.english: Privatisation was defended by some and criticised by others.

sections.content: In the passive, «ser + participio» agrees with the noun receiving the action.
